summary.en: Nomad eSIM uses Gemini to draft SOPs and sales documents, achieving a 15% increase in sales close rate.
summary.zh: Nomad eSIM 使用 Gemini 加速起草標準程序與文件，銷售成交率提升 15%，營運團隊節省 10% 時間。

overview.en: Nomad eSIM, a LotusFlare brand serving international travelers in 200+ destinations, deployed Gemini in Google Workspace to help employees rapidly draft standard operating procedures, sales documents, and internal communications. The AI accelerates content creation across Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet, freeing the operations team from repetitive writing tasks.
overview.zh: Nomad eSIM 是 LotusFlare 旗下品牌，服務全球 200 多個目的地的旅行者。該公司在 Google Workspace 中導入 Gemini，協助員工快速起草標準作業程序（SOP）、銷售文件及內部溝通內容，涵蓋 Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Slides 和 Meet，有效減少重複性寫作工作。

en: 15% increase in sales close rate attributed to AI-assisted document preparation.
10% of Operations team time saved in drafting standard operating procedures.
Gemini deployed across Google Workspace tools including Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet.
Serves travelers in 200+ destinations globally as a LotusFlare brand.
zh: 借助 AI 輔助文件準備，銷售成交率提升 15%。
運營團隊起草標準作業程序的時間節省 10%。
Gemini 部署於 Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Slides 和 Meet 等 Google Workspace 工具。
作為 LotusFlare 品牌，服務全球 200 多個目的地的旅行者。

summary.en: TELUS built Fuel iX on Vertex AI, delivering $90M+ in benefits and 500K+ hours saved across 57,000 employees.
summary.zh: TELUS 在 Vertex AI 上打造 Fuel iX 平台，為 57,000 多名員工創造逾 9,000 萬美元效益及節省 50 萬小時以上。

overview.en: TELUS built Fuel iX, a proprietary generative AI platform on Vertex AI, giving 57,000+ team members access to 40+ AI models including Anthropic's Claude and Gemini. The platform has enabled the creation of 13,000+ custom AI solutions across the enterprise, with engineering teams now shipping code 30% faster. Fuel iX runs 90% of AI model traffic through Vertex AI and has expanded beyond TELUS to serve external organizations.
overview.zh: TELUS 在 Vertex AI 上自建了名為 Fuel iX 的生成式 AI 平台，讓 57,000 多名員工可存取 40 多種 AI 模型，包括 Anthropic Claude 和 Gemini。該平台已催生逾 13,000 個自訂 AI 解決方案，工程團隊程式碼交付速度提升 30%。Fuel iX 有 90% 的 AI 流量通過 Vertex AI 處理，並已擴展至企業以外的外部組織。

en: Over $90 million in cumulative benefits delivered by 47 large-scale gen AI products.
500,000+ hours in time savings achieved across the organization.
Engineering teams shipping code 30% faster using AI assistance.
57,000+ employees actively using gen AI; 13,000+ custom AI solutions in production.
90% of AI model traffic routed through Vertex AI, supporting 40+ models from multiple vendors.
zh: 47 項大規模 gen AI 產品累計創造逾 9,000 萬美元效益。
全組織節省超過 50 萬小時。
工程團隊程式碼交付速度提升 30%。
57,000 多名員工積極使用 gen AI；逾 13,000 個自訂 AI 解決方案已投入生產。
90% 的 AI 模型流量通過 Vertex AI 路由，支援來自多個供應商的 40 多種模型。

summary.en: TIM Brasil uses Google Cloud gen AI to transcribe, classify, and summarize customer service calls in real time.
summary.zh: TIM Brasil 利用 Google Cloud 生成式 AI 即時轉錄、分類並摘要客服通話，提升服務品質與員工效率。

overview.en: TIM Brasil, a leading Brazilian telecom operator, uses Google Cloud's gen AI capabilities to transcribe audio from customer service calls and then automatically classify, summarize, and qualify each customer's demands with increasing precision. The solution assists live agents during calls and provides team feedback on best practices, creating a continuous improvement loop for customer service quality.
overview.zh: TIM Brasil 是巴西領先的電信業者，運用 Google Cloud 生成式 AI 能力對客服電話進行即時音訊轉錄，並自動分類、摘要和評估客戶需求，精準度持續提升。該解決方案在通話期間輔助真人客服，並為團隊提供最佳實踐反饋，形成客服品質的持續改善循環。

en: Real-time audio transcription of customer service calls using Google Cloud gen AI.
Automatic classification, summarization, and qualification of customer demands.
AI-assisted agents receive real-time coaching and next-best-action suggestions.
Continuous team feedback loop supports best practice sharing and service improvement.
zh: 利用 Google Cloud 生成式 AI 對客服電話進行即時音訊轉錄。
自動分類、摘要並評估客戶需求。
AI 輔助客服人員接收即時輔導與最佳行動建議。
持續的團隊反饋機制支持最佳實踐分享與服務改善。

summary.en: Verizon uses AI-powered enterprise search to help 28,000 frontline staff in network operations and customer care find answers faster.
summary.zh: Verizon 運用 AI 企業搜尋功能，協助 28,000 名前線員工在網路運營與客戶服務中更快速地找到所需資訊。

overview.en: Verizon, the largest U.S. wireless carrier, deployed AI-powered enterprise search tools to help teams in network operations and customer experience access information faster without manually searching through extensive knowledge bases. The tool provides 28,000 Verizon retail and customer care representatives with real-time, context-aware answers to customer inquiries, achieving a 95% answerability rate for customer questions.
overview.zh: 美國最大無線電信商 Verizon 部署了 AI 驅動的企業搜尋工具，協助網路運營與客戶體驗團隊快速存取資訊，無需手動翻查龐大的知識庫。該工具為 28,000 名零售與客服代表提供即時、具上下文感知的客戶查詢答案，客戶問題可解答率達 95%。

en: AI-powered search deployed to 28,000 Verizon retail and customer care representatives.
95% answerability rate for customer inquiries achieved.
Eliminates the need to manually search through extensive knowledge bases in real time.
Improves customer experience and operational efficiency across network and care teams.
zh: AI 搜尋工具部署給 28,000 名零售與客服代表。
客戶查詢可解答率達 95%。
消除了即時手動翻查龐大知識庫的需要。
提升網路和客服團隊的客戶體驗與營運效率。

summary.en: Verizon uses Gemini in Google Workspace to draft emails and documents; 82% of users report positive daily impact.
summary.zh: Verizon 使用 Google Workspace 的 Gemini 起草電子郵件與文件，82% 的用戶表示對日常工作有正面影響。

overview.en: Verizon deployed Gemini in Google Workspace to enable employees to create, refine, and summarize emails and lengthy documents, and identify action items from email chains. An internal user survey found that 82% of respondents feel Gemini makes a positive impact on their day-to-day operations, while 74% reported that using Gemini saves them time on routine tasks.
overview.zh: Verizon 在 Google Workspace 中部署 Gemini，讓員工能夠創建、修改和摘要電子郵件及長篇文件，並從郵件鏈中識別行動事項。內部用戶調查顯示，82% 的受訪者表示 Gemini 對其日常運營有正面影響，74% 表示使用 Gemini 節省了他們在例行任務上的時間。

en: 82% of surveyed users report Gemini makes a positive impact on day-to-day operations.
74% of users say Gemini saves them time on routine tasks.
Capabilities include drafting, refining, and summarizing emails and long documents.
Automatic identification of action items from email chains improves workflow efficiency.
zh: 82% 的受訪用戶表示 Gemini 對日常運營有正面影響。
74% 的用戶表示 Gemini 節省了例行任務時間。
功能涵蓋起草、修改和摘要電子郵件及長篇文件。
自動從郵件鏈識別行動事項，提升工作流程效率。

summary.en: Virgin Media O2 uses AI-powered Knowledge Catalog to activate 20,000+ data assets for global product teams.
summary.zh: Virgin Media O2 運用 AI 知識目錄盤活逾 20,000 個數據資產，賦能全球產品團隊。

overview.en: Virgin Media O2 (VMO2) had over 20,000 data assets distributed across a federated architecture, many of which were untapped. The company deployed an AI-powered Smart Metadata solution using Dataplex Universal Catalog and BigQuery Data Insights, which automatically generates rich, contextual metadata by analyzing schemas, data profiles, and relationships. This enables global product teams to discover, govern, and leverage data assets at scale.
overview.zh: Virgin Media O2（VMO2）在分散式架構中擁有逾 20,000 個數據資產，其中許多從未被充分利用。公司透過 Dataplex Universal Catalog 和 BigQuery Data Insights 部署了 AI 驅動的 Smart Metadata 解決方案，透過分析結構描述、數據剖析和關聯性，自動生成豐富的上下文元數據，讓全球產品團隊得以大規模發現、治理及使用數據資產。

en: Over 20,000 data assets activated through AI-generated metadata in Dataplex Universal Catalog.
AI automatically generates descriptions by analyzing schema, data profiles, and relationships.
Data contracts framework ensures published datasets are reliable, documented, and compliance-ready.
Global product teams empowered to discover and use data assets independently.
zh: 透過 Dataplex Universal Catalog 的 AI 生成元數據，盤活逾 20,000 個數據資產。
AI 透過分析結構描述、數據剖析及關聯性，自動生成資料描述。
數據合約框架確保已發布的數據集可靠、有文件記錄且符合合規要求。
全球產品團隊可自行探索並使用數據資產。

summary.en: Vodafone uses Vertex AI to search and analyze commercial terms across 10,000+ contracts with 800+ operators.
summary.zh: Vodafone 利用 Vertex AI 搜尋並分析與逾 800 家電信商簽訂的 10,000 多份合約中的商業條款。

overview.en: Vodafone deployed Vertex AI to help its network development teams rapidly search and understand specific commercial terms and conditions across more than 10,000 contracts with more than 800 communications operators. The AI solution extracts key clauses and provides valuable insights for contract template generation, drastically reducing the manual effort required to manage vast amounts of contractual data across Vodafone's European and African operations.
overview.zh: Vodafone 部署 Vertex AI，協助網路開發團隊快速搜尋並理解與逾 800 家電信商簽訂的 10,000 多份合約中的特定商業條款。AI 解決方案能擷取關鍵條款並提供合約範本生成所需的重要見解，大幅降低管理龐大合約數據所需的人工作業量。

en: Vertex AI analyzes over 10,000 contracts with more than 800 communications operators.
Extracts key clauses and generates insights for contract template creation.
Reduces manual effort for network development teams managing contractual data.
Part of Vodafone's broader $1 billion, 10-year strategic partnership with Google Cloud.
zh: Vertex AI 分析與逾 800 家電信商簽訂的 10,000 多份合約。
擷取關鍵條款並為合約範本創建提供見解。
降低網路開發團隊管理合約數據的人工作業量。
此為 Vodafone 與 Google Cloud 總值 10 億美元、為期 10 年戰略合作夥伴關係的一部分。

summary.en: Vodafone and Quantexa built a 360-degree customer view on Google Cloud to deliver actionable decision intelligence.
summary.zh: Vodafone 與 Quantexa 在 Google Cloud 上打造 360 度客戶視圖，提供可行的決策智慧。

overview.en: Vodafone worked with Quantexa to build a Decision Intelligence platform on Google Cloud, providing a unified 360-degree view of each customer. The solution combines Vodafone's data with Quantexa's AI-driven decision intelligence capabilities to surface clear customer insights that enable improved service experiences and more informed business actions across Vodafone's operations.
overview.zh: Vodafone 與 Quantexa 合作，在 Google Cloud 上打造決策智慧平台，提供每位客戶的統一 360 度視圖。該解決方案將 Vodafone 的數據與 Quantexa 的 AI 驅動決策智慧能力相結合，呈現清晰的客戶洞察，進而改善服務體驗並在 Vodafone 整體業務中支援更明智的商業決策。

en: 360-degree customer view built on Google Cloud using Quantexa's Decision Intelligence platform.
Surfaces clear, actionable customer insights for improved service experiences.
Combines Vodafone's internal data with AI-driven intelligence from Quantexa.
Supports more informed business decisions across Vodafone's operations.
zh: 基於 Google Cloud，使用 Quantexa Decision Intelligence 平台建立 360 度客戶視圖。
呈現清晰可行的客戶洞察，改善服務體驗。
結合 Vodafone 內部數據與 Quantexa 的 AI 驅動智慧。
支援 Vodafone 全業務更明智的商業決策。

summary.en: Banglalink's Gemini-powered REN chatbot autonomously handles 95% of Ryze customer interactions in English, Bengali, and Banglish.
summary.zh: Banglalink 的 Gemini 驅動聊天機器人 REN 自主處理 Ryze 品牌 95% 的客戶互動，支援英語、孟加拉語和「Banglish」。

overview.en: Banglalink, a leading Bangladeshi telecom operator, launched REN, a Gemini-powered generative AI chatbot for its Ryze digital brand, to provide fully digital customer service to millions of young users. The chatbot handles balance inquiries, package purchases, bill payments, and SIM services in English, Bengali, and 'Banglish' (Bengali written in Roman script). Built in partnership with Google and powered by Riafy Technologies, REN is the first AI-powered chat engine in Bangladesh's telecom sector.
overview.zh: 孟加拉領先電信商 Banglalink 為其 Ryze 數位品牌推出由 Gemini 驅動的 REN 聊天機器人，為數百萬年輕用戶提供全數位化客戶服務。REN 支援英語、孟加拉語和「Banglish」（羅馬字拼寫的孟加拉語），處理餘額查詢、套餐購買、帳單支付及 SIM 卡服務，是孟加拉電信業首個 AI 聊天引擎。

en: 95% of Ryze customer interactions managed autonomously by the REN chatbot.
Only 4% of interactions require human agent intervention.
Supports three languages: English, Bengali, and Banglish (Bengali in Roman script).
First AI-powered chat engine launched in Bangladesh's telecom industry.
Built on Google Gemini with Riafy Technologies as the Google Cloud partner.
zh: REN 聊天機器人自主處理 95% 的 Ryze 客戶互動。
僅 4% 的互動需要人工客服介入。
支援三種語言：英語、孟加拉語及 Banglish（羅馬字母孟加拉語）。
孟加拉電信業首個 AI 聊天引擎。
基於 Google Gemini 構建，Riafy Technologies 為 Google Cloud 合作夥伴。

summary.en: Bell Canada deployed AI-powered contact center solutions with Agent Assist, contributing $20M in customer operations savings.
summary.zh: Bell Canada 部署 AI 驅動的聯絡中心解決方案並引入 Agent Assist，為客戶運營節省 2,000 萬美元。

overview.en: Bell Canada built customizable Google Cloud-powered contact center solutions for its business customers, offering AI agents to handle callers and an Agent Assist tool that provides real-time suggestions and sentiment analysis to human agents. The platform, deployed at world-first scale for a contact center of this size, has contributed $20 million in savings across Bell's customer operations. Bell is also reselling these solutions to Canadian businesses through its Google Cloud Contact Center AI partnership.
overview.zh: Bell Canada 為其企業客戶打造可自訂的 Google Cloud 驅動聯絡中心解決方案，提供 AI 客服代理接聽來電，並透過 Agent Assist 工具為人工客服提供即時建議和情緒分析。該平台以全球首例的規模部署於如此大型的聯絡中心，已為 Bell 的客戶運營節省 2,000 萬美元，同時也透過 Google Cloud CCAI 合作關係向加拿大企業轉售這些解決方案。

en: $20 million in savings contributed across Bell Canada's customer operations from AI.
AI virtual agents handle inbound callers; Agent Assist supports human agents in real time.
Agent Assist provides step-by-step recommendations and sentiment analysis during calls.
First fully AI-powered contact center solution for Canadian enterprise customers at this scale.
Bell is also reselling CCAI solutions to Canadian businesses as part of the Google Cloud partnership.
zh: AI 技術為 Bell Canada 客戶運營節省 2,000 萬美元。
AI 虛擬代理處理呼入電話；Agent Assist 即時支援人工客服。
Agent Assist 在通話期間提供逐步建議和情緒分析。
加拿大企業客戶中首個以如此規模部署的全 AI 驅動聯絡中心解決方案。
Bell 亦透過 Google Cloud 合作關係向加拿大企業轉售 CCAI 解決方案。

summary.en: Deutsche Telekom built MINDR, a multi-agentic AI system with Google Gemini that reduces major network event management from hours to ~1 minute.
summary.zh: Deutsche Telekom 聯合 Google 打造多代理 AI 系統 MINDR，將重大網路事件管理時間從數小時縮短至約 1 分鐘。

overview.en: Deutsche Telekom, in partnership with Google Cloud, developed MINDR (Multi-Agentic Intelligent Network Diagnostics & Remediation), a multi-agentic AI system built on Google's Gemini models and Vertex AI. MINDR shifts network operations from reactive troubleshooting to predictive, service-driven automation, correlating signals end-to-end across RAN, transport, and core domains to detect, diagnose, and resolve issues before they impact customers — reducing the time to manage major events from hours to approximately one minute.
overview.zh: Deutsche Telekom 與 Google Cloud 合作開發了 MINDR（多代理智慧網路診斷與修復）系統，基於 Google Gemini 模型和 Vertex AI 構建。MINDR 將網路運營從被動故障排除轉變為預測性、服務導向的自動化，跨 RAN、傳輸和核心網域端到端關聯訊號，在問題影響客戶前進行偵測、診斷和修復，將重大事件管理時間從數小時縮短至約 1 分鐘。

en: Reduces time to manage major network events from hours to approximately one minute.
MINDR correlates signals across RAN, transport, and core network domains end-to-end.
Uses Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for multi-agent coordination.
Shifts network operations from reactive troubleshooting to predictive automation.
Built on Google Gemini models via Vertex AI as part of Deutsche Telekom's AI-Native Telco strategy.
zh: 將重大網路事件管理時間從數小時縮短至約 1 分鐘。
MINDR 跨 RAN、傳輸和核心網域端到端關聯訊號。
採用 Agent-to-Agent（A2A）協議進行多代理協調。
將網路運營從被動故障排除轉變為預測性自動化。
基於 Vertex AI 上的 Google Gemini 模型構建，是 Deutsche Telekom AI-Native Telco 戰略的一部分。

summary.en: LG U+ integrated Gemini into its ixi-O phone agent to deliver actionable AI with real-time intent understanding and plans for international expansion.
summary.zh: LG U+ 將 Gemini 整合至 ixi-O 電話 AI 助理，提供即時意圖理解能力，並計劃拓展國際市場。

overview.en: LG U+, the South Korean mobile network operator, integrated Gemini into its ixi-O AI phone agent to enable more actionable AI that understands user intent and responds accordingly in real time. The company also uses the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to add features that recommend responses during calls. LG U+ aims to expand ixi-O internationally, targeting $300 million in revenue by 2028, with ongoing negotiations with telecom operators in Southeast Asia.
overview.zh: 韓國行動網路電信商 LG U+ 將 Gemini 整合至 ixi-O AI 電話助理，實現即時理解用戶意圖並作出相應回應的 AI 能力。公司亦使用 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 新增通話期間的回應推薦功能。LG U+ 計劃在國際市場拓展 ixi-O，目標在 2028 年前達成 3 億美元收益，目前正與東南亞電信商進行洽談。

en: Gemini integrated into ixi-O for real-time user intent understanding and response during calls.
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform adds in-call response recommendation features.
International expansion target of $300 million in revenue by 2028.
Active partnership negotiations with Southeast Asian telecom operators.
Ultra-low-latency streaming AI engine interprets user intent without interrupting conversation flow.
zh: Gemini 整合至 ixi-O，實現通話期間的即時用戶意圖理解與回應。
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 新增通話中回應推薦功能。
國際擴張目標：2028 年前達成 3 億美元收益。
積極與東南亞電信商洽談合作。
超低延遲串流 AI 引擎在不打斷對話流程的情況下理解用戶意圖。

summary.en: Liberty Global is integrating Gemini into Horizon TV and care channels across ~80M connections via a five-year Google Cloud AI partnership.
summary.zh: Liberty Global 透過五年 Google Cloud AI 合作協議，將 Gemini 整合至 Horizon TV 及客服渠道，覆蓋約 8,000 萬個連接。

overview.en: Liberty Global, a European telecom company with approximately 80 million connections across brands including Virgin Media O2, Telenet, VodafoneZiggo, and Sunrise, announced a five-year strategic AI partnership with Google Cloud in February 2026. The company is integrating Gemini models into its Horizon TV platform to make content search and discovery smarter and more conversational, while also extending AI into care channels to improve responsiveness and first-contact resolution. The partnership also covers autonomous network operations and data sovereignty.
